summary: A three-day Chiba trip from Makuhari to the Boso Peninsula. It has an unadon lunch at Kawatoyo in Narita, a full day at Mother Farm, and a Mount Nokogiri and Nihon-ji day before the evening flight from Narita. Several places and bookings you named are not yet in the plan: Naritasan, Omotesando, both rental-car stops and a Kisarazu hotel.
